title: ooRexx Foreign Runtime binding
summary: The existing Foreign Runtime v0.22.6 provides native calls. ServicePlayout.cls owns application-facing coordination and invokes the bridge, keeping frames and PCM in native code rather than copying each raw frame through ooRexx.
invariants: Do not replace the accepted Foreign Runtime ABI or introduce a second loader/FFI.
Object~start collides with a native start method; call native~invokeArray('start', .array~new) explicitly.
Dev3 updates the FFI wrapper but the exact ooRexx interpreter/Foreign Runtime call path was NOT re-executed in the dev3 build environment.
Source and test assertions must not be promoted to live FFI execution evidence.
procedure: Verify the actual JSON bridge descriptor and Foreign Runtime v0.22.6 loader with the user's ooRexx r13196 runtime.
Run tests/foreign_probe.rex and interactive preview only after the native build is qualified.
Record runtime and descriptor SHA-256 alongside execution logs; preserve per-process device ownership.

provenance.claim: ooRexx wrapper and explicit native start invocation.
Explicit statement that FFI was updated but not executed in dev3 environment.
